name: Kispáli (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kispáli (a blue and green shield with a church, a bunch of grapes, ears of grain and a hand) above the name KISPÁLI in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
